rows.Origin:
Bred by Vittorio Barni (1914-1999) (Italy, 1979).
Introduced in Italy by Rose Barni in 1982 as 'Fragrant Love'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
